Package index

Detect & classify a column

The primary entry point. Route a column to its ontology type and reconcile value- and name-based evidence.

guess_data_type()
Guess the ontology-anchored data type of a column
guess_column()
Guess a column's type from its values and its name
score_data_type()
Score a column against every registered detector
classify_by_name()
Classify a column by its variable name
fx_classify_column()
Classify a single column under deployment rules (sample + gate + score)
fx_classify_df()
Classify every column of a data frame under deployment rules

Stabilize

Execute an ontology recipe to normalize a column to its stable form.

fx_stabilize()
Stabilize a column via its ontology recipe
fx_transform()
Run an ontology transform-DSL expression on a vector

The ontology

The shared vocabulary of semantic types, plus tooling to audit and evolve it.

fx_ontology()
The research data-type ontology (v6)
fx_validate_ontology()
Integrity-check an ontology table
fx_ontology_diff()
Classify the differences between two ontology versions
fx_ontology_impact_table()
Ontology change impact table
fx_impacted_cases()
Map an ontology diff onto banked cases
fx_migrate_bank()
Apply the mechanical half of a bank migration
fx_relabel_queue()
The relabel work list, highest-value first
fx_dgf_fields()
Format a type prediction as governance-file (DGF) fields
fx_triage_field()
Triage a column for banking as a test case

Column detectors

Deterministic value predicates, one per format. A column is typed by the share of its values a detector accepts.

Feature extraction & signatures

The value-profile the routers are built on, and the lightweight signature primitives derived from it.

fx_extract_features()
Extract the value-profile feature vector for a column
fx_extract_features_df()
Extract features for every column of a data frame
fx_feature_manifest()
Map each feature to its block and cascade tier
fx_blocks_for_features()
Minimal set of feature blocks needed for a set of features
default_lexicons()
Default controlled-vocabulary lexicons for the lexicon feature block
fx_type_signature()
Reduce a column to its 7-number type signature
fx_signature_distance()
Weighted distance between two type signatures
fx_path_distance()
Taxonomic distance between two ontology paths
fx_sibling_report()
Surface confusable type pairs through the taxonomy and the data
SIGNATURE_WEIGHTS
Signature axis weights (balanced default)
WEIGHTS_FORMAT
Signature axis weights tuned for format comparisons

Test-case bank & auditing

fx_make_test_case()
Build a banked test case from a column
fx_index_bank()
Index a directory of banked test cases
fx_bank_coverage()
Coverage of a test-case bank by type and difficulty
fx_roundtrip_check()
Check whether stabilized values survive a read/write round trip
fx_audit_ontology()
Round-trip audit an ontology file

Evaluation & AutoType reporting

evaluate_columns()
Evaluate formex predictions against a labeled column corpus
eval_summary()
Summarize an evaluation into overall and per-class metrics
feasibility_score()
Score one ontology assignment by feasibility
score_feasibility_table()
Score a table of predictions against a feasibility crosswalk
generate_autotype_negatives()
Generate negative examples for a mutation tier
generate_autotype_report()
Print an autotype error report for a results table
generate_autotype_test_cases()
Build a labelled test-case table for one data type
autotype_summary()
Summarize an autotype results table by mutation tier
autotype_summary_row()
One master-table row for a data type
build_autotype_results()
Run a detector against positives and generated negatives
